★★★ THE `.cfi_*` FAMILY, READ FROM A REAL `.s` — THE DIRECTIVE CLASS COMPILER OUTPUT IS ACTUALLY MADE OF. ✔MEASURED 2026-08-13 with `gcc -O1 -fno-ident -fcf-protection=none -S` on a five-line C function: SIX `.cfi_*` lines against FIVE instructions, because `-fasynchronous-unwind-tables` is ON BY DEFAULT on every Linux target. Until this example, `asm-x86_64-att` refused `.cfi_startproc` by name (`A0008`), which means it could not read ONE FUNCTION of its own reference compiler's output no matter what else it supported. This file is the witness that it now can.

★★★ WHAT MAKES IT A TEST RATHER THAN A PARSE DEMO: EVERY DECLARED SPELLING APPEARS, AND THE ARITHMETIC AROUND THEM IS LOAD-BEARING. All EIGHTEEN `.cfi_*` rows in `asm-x86_64-att.lang.json` are exercised here, so deleting ANY ONE of them turns this example red at `A0008` naming that spelling — the red-on-disable is per-ROW, not per-family. And the directives are INTERLEAVED with the computation (`100 − 7 = 93`, spilled to `32(%rsp)`, reloaded, `× 2 = 186`, then `helper(186, 144) = 42`) rather than bracketing it, so a directive that swallowed a following line, or a walker that resynchronized past one, changes the exit code instead of passing quietly. ⚠ THAT INTERLEAVING IS THE POINT: a file with `.cfi_startproc` … instructions … `.cfi_endproc` would stay green even if every directive between them ate the next line.

★★★ ✔MEASURED AGAINST GNU as ITSELF, WHICH IS THE ONLY CHECK THAT SETTLES 'IS THIS REAL GAS': `as main.s -o main.o` returns rc=0 and the object carries TWO `.eh_frame` sections. Per [[feedback_reference_compilers_are_the_spec]] that check is REQUIRED and it is bidirectional — a corpus file the reference assembler would reject is exactly as wrong as a refusal of input it accepts, and `.cfi_signal_frame` / `.cfi_return_column` are the two rows most likely to have been written into a shape gas does not take. `.cfi_return_column 16` restates the x86_64 DEFAULT (DWARF register 16 is the return address), so it is a no-op that still exercises the row.

★★ AND THE SAME MEASUREMENT IS THE HONEST STATEMENT OF WHAT IS LOST. gas emits 2 `.eh_frame` sections from these directives; ✔MEASURED on the ELF this example produces, DSS emits ZERO — `readelf -S` finds no `.eh_frame` at all. The verb is `ignoredAnnotation`, so an accepted `.cfi_*` produces a function that is CORRECT TO EXECUTE and IMPOSSIBLE TO UNWIND: no debugger backtrace through the frame, and a C++ exception thrown through it terminates instead of propagating. That is an accept-and-ignore with a silent RUNTIME consequence, which this project normally refuses; it is taken because the alternative is refusing every compiler-emitted `.s` outright, and it is ANCHORED rather than shrugged at — D-ASM-CFI-UNWIND-INFO-SILENTLY-DROPPED. ⇒ WHEN UNWIND EMISSION LANDS, THIS EXAMPLE MUST GROW AN `.eh_frame` ASSERTION, not merely keep passing: an example that would stay green whether or not the directives were honoured is exactly the pin that ends up asserting nothing.

★ WHAT IS STILL UNDECLARED, AND STAYS FAIL-LOUD: `.cfi_personality`, `.cfi_lsda` and `.cfi_sections` are absent, because all three take a DOTTED SYMBOL operand (`DW.ref.__gxx_personality_v0`, `.debug_frame`) that no `attOperand` arm can open. ✔MEASURED: `.cfi_sections .debug_frame` fails at `P0001 expected 'LineEnd' — got '.'`, i.e. at the grammar, not silently. A row declared for a spelling whose operands cannot parse would read as support and deliver a parse error, so those three are deliberately not declared. Anchored under D-ASM-ATT-GAS-SURFACE-INCOMPLETE.

★ THE FRAME IS HAND-WRITTEN BECAUSE THAT IS WHAT THE `encode` TIER MEANS: `subq $40, %rsp` / `addq $40, %rsp` is the programmer's own prologue and epilogue, `materializeCallingConvention` does not run at this tier, and `32(%rsp)` sits above the 32-byte region Win64 reserves as shadow space — so one file is correct under both ABIs. Only registers volatile under BOTH ABIs are touched (rax, rcx, rdx), the same discipline `asm_x86_64_branch_call_memory` documents.

★ THE `release` ARM, SCOPED HONESTLY. At the `encode` tier no MIR module exists, so the optimizer, the register allocator and calling-convention materialization never run — this arm does NOT witness the optimizer and cannot. It pins the narrower fact that `--config=release` still produces a working binary, i.e. the release configuration does not BREAK the assembly path.

optimizedPipelines.$commentByteIdentical: MEASURED 2026-08-15 — optimized image BYTE-IDENTICAL to the baseline on: x86_64:elf64-x86_64-linux-exec, x86_64:pe64-x86_64-windows-exec. Legs actually run: windows/pe64-x86_64 and linux/elf64 (x86_64 + aarch64 under qemu); the darwin/macho64 leg was NOT run. Where the image is identical the arm's exit-code/stdout comparison is x==x and cannot fail. HONEST BY CONSTRUCTION: the source of this example IS assembly, so it is assembled without ever forming the HIR/MIR an optimizer pass runs on. No pipeline can transform it and no edit to this example could ever make this arm differ — the arm still earns its place by pinning that naming a pipeline does not BREAK an assembly example. Deliberately NOT given "mustDifferFromBaseline" — an honest no-op, not a missed opt-in.
